mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly increase in GDP (GDPC1) signals stronger economic momentum, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when GDPC1 shows no upward trend over the past quarter.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in federal funds rates above 3% triggers a negative S&P 500 forward return over the next 60 trading days, reflecting market anticipation of higher borrowing costs.
failure_condition: 60-day returns not significantly negative (p > 0.05) when FEDFUNDS does not exceed 3% in the trigger period.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent increases in quarterly GDP (GDPC1) and monthly labor demand (PAYEMS) signal robust economic activity, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: both GDPC1 and PAYEMS increase in the same month
failure_condition: 5-day returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when both proxies rise, or when only one proxy increases while the other does not.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the unemployment rate below 4% signals a tight labor market, fostering positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when UNRATE does not fall below 4% in the trigger period.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the supply index (INDPRO) reflects robust production capacity, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when INDPRO shows no upward trend over the past month.

mechanism_narrative: An upward surge in the supply index (INDPRO) above 115 signals robust production, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when INDPRO does not exceed 115 in the trigger period.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low demand (RSAFS < 400M) and low federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS < 3%) signals economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day returns not significantly positive when both proxies are in the trigger condition, or when only one proxy meets the threshold.

mechanism_narrative: Rising labor demand (PAYEMS) alongside falling unemployment (UNRATE) in the same month signals a tight labor market, fostering positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increasing and UNRATE decreasing in the same month
failure_condition: 5-day returns not significantly positive when both proxies meet the trigger condition, or when only one proxy changes while the other does not.
